RELEASE FRIDAY 🇮🇹 — MACE

SANGHA is out today via Atlantic Records Italy / Warner Music Italy: 18 tracks, 28 guests, from 22simba to Gianna Nannini, with Salmo, Noyz Narcos, Gemitaiz, Izi, Nayt, Colapesce and Venerus in the circle. Mace built it during a three-week residency in Tuscany with more than 60 people taking turns, the same method behind MĀYĀ. The title is Sanskrit for "community".

🎧 Track: Splendida follia – MACE, centomilacarie, Gianna Nannini

Which guest steals SANGHA? Comment below.

RELEASE FRIDAY 🇪🇺 — Sido vs RnBoi

🇩🇪 Sido drops Frieden, his tenth solo studio album and the first since Paul (2022): 15 tracks, guests on nine, including Gzuz, Kontra K, Fler, Shindy, Marteria and Sarah Connor. The Frieden Tour 2027 hits arenas in Germany, Austria and Switzerland next autumn.
🇫🇷 RnBoi answers with Après Minuit: 12 tracks via Double Jeu Records & Nakamura Industrie.

🎧 Track: Propaganda – Sido, Fler

Which one gets your first play? Comment 1 (Frieden) or 2 (Après Minuit).
